# Isaias Santos

> Solution Architect specializing in distributed systems and AI-enabled platforms — Next.js, TypeScript, and Contentful headless CMS.

Isaias Santos is a Solution Architect who designs and builds distributed
systems and AI-enabled platforms for commerce, ERP, and customer-facing
products. His work spans solution and system design, event-driven
architectures on AWS, and hands-on delivery across the JavaScript ecosystem:
Next.js and React on the frontend, Node.js services on the backend, GraphQL
APIs, and headless CMS architectures with Contentful. This site is his
portfolio and a living example of that stack: a Next.js App Router application
whose pages, sections, and components are fully managed in Contentful, so new
landing pages can be created and updated without code changes.

## About this site

The site is deliberately built as a demonstration of the practices Isaias
works with:

- **Next.js (App Router)** for server rendering, per-page metadata, and
  strong Core Web Vitals.
- **Contentful** as the single source of content: pages are composed of
  sections and components modeled in the CMS and fetched over GraphQL.
- **AWS Amplify** for low-cost hosting and continuous deployment.
- Semantic HTML, JSON-LD structured data, a sitemap, and a robots policy
  that explicitly welcomes both traditional and AI search crawlers.

## WebMCP tools

The site implements the WebMCP proposal (https://github.com/webmachinelearning/webmcp):
a browser-side bridge registers structured tools on `document.modelContext`
so AI agents can call site functionality directly instead of scraping the
DOM. Tools available on every page:

- `get_profile`: returns profile JSON — name, role (Solution Architect |
  Distributed Systems & AI-Enabled Platforms), summary, skills (Next.js,
  React, TypeScript, Contentful, GraphQL,
  Tailwind CSS, AWS, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude), RAG, prompt engineering,
  AI agents (MCP/WebMCP), LLMO / AI-friendly SEO), and social links
  (GitHub, LinkedIn, Medium).
- `list_pages`: returns every page of this site with URLs and optional
  lastmod dates, read live from `/sitemap.xml`.
- `get_page_content`: returns the current page's title, URL, and visible
  text content as JSON (capped at 10,000 characters).
- `navigate_to_page`: navigates the browser to another page of this site;
  accepts a site-relative path (e.g. `/about`) or an absolute URL on this
  site and refuses to leave the site.
- `toggle_theme`: switches the color theme between dark and light and
  returns the newly applied theme.
